completed: P0.4 bounded foundation: added provider-neutral ingestion ledger with stable work/run/stage/item IDs, content+processor fingerprints, atomic state, deduplication, incremental requeue, explicit item states, checkpoint cursors, and interrupted-claim recovery.
Added focused tests/test_ingestion.py and docs/resumable-ingestion.md; recorded progress in the P0.4 roadmap.
decisions: Processor-version changes are allowed when reopening a ledger; existing items are requeued only when enqueue observes a changed content or processor fingerprint.
The ledger is metadata-only and assumes one active worker per ledger; provider adapters and concurrency are intentionally out of scope for this bounded stage.
remaining: Wire the ledger into one real provider adapter, starting with the smallest safe local/import path; preserve provider-specific behavior behind the ledger API.
Add adapter-level interruption/resumption tests before extending to iCloud Mail, Drive, messages, feeds, or document batches.
